properties.name: Massachusetts
properties.summary: On the cold shores of the northern Atlantic, Massachusetts binds proud free cities, inland lordships and ancient bishoprics beneath the white blossom of its banner. From the quays of Middlesex to the halls of Worcester, merchants and nobles bargain over the price of liberty. United against the Anglo-Saxon crown, they provision the rebellion even as old rivalries trouble the kingdom within.

properties.name: The Sidennic League
properties.summary: Across Antillia, the Seven Sister Cities preserve their Roman inheritance through a council-led league of merchant republics. Bound together since 555, their patricians, condottieri and traders have turned isolation into a nine-century experiment in commerce, rivalry and survival.
